description: Spotify podcast show — publisher, rating, topics, explicit flag, and totalEpisodes as clean JSON. Costs 1 credit. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

url.description: Spotify show/podcast URL, URI, or ID (e.g. https://open.spotify.com/show/…). Not an artist URL.
